insight: Prague-founded (2023); a $21M Series A led by Insight Partners in 2025, with most of the Fortune 100 signed up.
name: E2B
tagline: Secure cloud sandboxes for running AI-generated code.
description: Open-source infrastructure that spins up isolated cloud sandboxes so AI agents can execute generated code safely. Python and JS/TS SDKs cover code interpretation, data analysis, and computer-use desktops, with per-second billing. Self-host or BYOC/on-prem is supported for enterprise.

modelSupport.notes: Runtime for any agent/model; integrates with OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, and Llama.

edge: Firecracker microVM isolation with stateful sessions — code interpreter pattern where vars persist across agent turns.
cons: Per-second billing adds up at scale
